title: CI 持续混沌集成
markdown:
# CI 持续混沌集成

将混沌实验纳入 CI/CD 流水线，是混沌工程从 L3 跃升到 L4 的核心标志。**持续混沌（Continuous Chaos）**的理念：每次代码变更都自动验证系统韧性，而不是等到季度 GameDay 才运行实验。本篇介绍如何用 GitHub Actions 实现混沌实验自动化，以及"混沌实验即代码"（Chaos-as-Code）的完整实践。

## 核心概念

| 概念                            | 说明                                                               |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 持续混沌（Continuous Chaos）    | 将混沌实验集成到 CI/CD 流水线，每次代码变更自动触发韧性验证        |
| 混沌实验即代码（Chaos-as-Code） | ChaosEngine YAML 与应用代码同仓库管理，支持版本化、审查和复用      |
| 稳态假说自动验证                | 通过 Prometheus Probe 在实验期间持续轮询稳态指标，自动判定实验结果 |
| 渐进式实验策略                  | Staging 全量 → Canary 低强度 → 生产随机注入的三阶段覆盖路径        |
| Pre-flight Check                | 执行生产混沌实验前的安全检查，确认当前无活跃告警再开始注入         |
| 反馈环压缩                      | 将"引入韧性退化 → 发现问题"的时间间隔从数月压缩到每次 PR 的分钟级  |

## 持续混沌的核心思路

传统混沌工程的问题是**时间间隔太长**：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[代码变更] --> B[发布到生产] --> C[某月 GameDay] --> D[发现韧性退化]
    D --> E[修复] --> A

```

在这个循环里，从"引入韧性退化"到"发现问题"可能有数周甚至数月的延迟。

持续混沌的目标是压缩这个反馈环：

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[代码变更] --> B[PR 自动触发\n混沌套件] --> C{稳态验证}
    C -->|通过| D[部署到生产]
    C -->|失败| E[阻断部署\n通知开发者]
    E --> A

```

## 混沌实验即代码（Chaos-as-Code）

混沌实验应该像应用代码一样管理：版本化、可复用、可审查。

### ChaosEngine YAML 存入 Git 仓库

推荐的仓库结构：

```
your-service/
├── src/                          # 应用源码
├── k8s/                          # Kubernetes 部署配置
│   ├── deployment.yaml
│   └── service.yaml
└── chaos/                        # 混沌实验配置
    ├── README.md                  # 实验说明
    ├── steady-state.yaml          # 稳态假说定义
    ├── experiments/
    │   ├── pod-delete.yaml        # Pod 删除实验
    │   ├── network-latency.yaml   # 网络延迟实验
    │   └── cpu-stress.yaml        # CPU 压力实验
    └── suites/
        ├── staging-suite.yaml     # Staging 回归套件
        └── canary-suite.yaml      # 生产 Canary 套件
```

### 稳态假说定义文件

```yaml
# chaos/steady-state.yaml
apiVersion: chaos.example.com/v1
kind: SteadyStateHypothesis
metadata:
  name: payment-service-steady-state
spec:
  service: payment-service
  probes:
    - name: http-success-rate
      type: prometheus
      query: |
        rate(http_requests_total{status!~"5..",service="payment"}[5m]) /
        rate(http_requests_total{service="payment"}[5m])
      expectedMin: 0.99 # 期望 99% 成功率

    - name: p99-latency
      type: prometheus
      query: |
        histogram_quantile(0.99,
          rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="payment"}[5m])
        )
      expectedMax: 0.2 # 期望 p99 < 200ms

    - name: pod-ready-count
      type: kubernetes
      resource: deployment/payment-service
      field: status.readyReplicas
      expectedMin: 2 # 至少 2 个 Pod 就绪
```

### ChaosEngine 实验文件

```yaml
# chaos/experiments/pod-delete.yaml
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:
  name: payment-pod-delete-ci
  namespace: staging
  labels:
    chaos-suite: staging # 标记属于哪个套件
    chaos-level: safe # safe / moderate / aggressive
spec:
  appinfo:
    appns: staging
    applabel: 'app=payment-service'
    appkind: deployment

  engineState: active
  chaosServiceAccount: litmus-ci-sa

  experiments:
    - name: pod-delete
      spec:
        components:
          env:
            - name: TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION
              value: '60'
            - name: CHAOS_INTERVAL
              value: '15'
            - name: PODS_AFFECTED_PERC
              value: '50'
            - name: FORCE
              value: 'false'
        probe:
          - name: check-http-success-rate
            type: promProbe
            mode: Continuous
            runProperties:
              probeTimeout: 5
              retry: 2
              interval: 5
            promProbe/inputs:
              endpoint: 'http://prometheus:9090'
              query: |
                rate(http_requests_total{status!~"5..",service="payment"}[2m]) /
                rate(http_requests_total{service="payment"}[2m])
              comparator:
                type: float
                criteria: '>='
                value: '0.99'
```

## GitHub Actions 集成

### 基础：PR 触发 Staging 混沌验证

```yaml
# .github/workflows/chaos-validation.yaml
name: Chaos Validation

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, staging]
  push:
    branches: [staging]

jobs:
  chaos-staging:
    name: Chaos Validation - Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3

      - name: Configure kubeconfig (Staging)
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.STAGING_KUBECONFIG }}" > /tmp/kubeconfig
          export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/kubeconfig

      - name: Deploy to Staging
        run: kubectl apply -f k8s/ -n staging

      - name: Wait for Staging Ready
        run: |
          kubectl rollout status deployment/payment-service \
            -n staging --timeout=300s

      - name: Verify Steady State (Pre-Chaos)
        id: pre-chaos-check
        run: |
          node scripts/check-steady-state.js \
            --config chaos/steady-state.yaml \
            --namespace staging

      - name: Apply Chaos Experiments
        if: steps.pre-chaos-check.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f chaos/experiments/ -n staging

      - name: Wait for Chaos Completion
        run: |
          kubectl wait chaosengine/payment-pod-delete-ci \
            --for=jsonpath='{.status.engineStatus}'=completed \
            -n staging \
            --timeout=300s

      - name: Collect Chaos Results
        id: chaos-results
        run: |
          RESULT=$(kubectl get chaosresult payment-pod-delete-ci-pod-delete \
            -n staging -o jsonpath='{.status.experimentStatus.verdict}')
          echo "verdict=$RESULT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Verify Steady State (Post-Chaos)
        run: |
          node scripts/check-steady-state.js \
            --config chaos/steady-state.yaml \
            --namespace staging

      - name: Fail if Chaos Verdict is Fail
        if: steps.chaos-results.outputs.verdict == 'Fail'
        run: |
          echo "Chaos experiment failed - system did not maintain steady state"
          exit 1

      - name: Cleanup Chaos Resources
        if: always()
        run: kubectl delete -f chaos/experiments/ -n staging --ignore-not-found
```

### 进阶：稳态自动验证脚本

```javascript
// scripts/check-steady-state.js
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { parse } from 'yaml';

const config = parse(readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));

async function checkProbe(probe) {
  if (probe.type === 'prometheus') {
    const url = `${process.env.PROMETHEUS_URL}/api/v1/query`;
    const response = await fetch(`${url}?query=${encodeURIComponent(probe.query)}`);
    const data = await response.json();
    const value = parseFloat(data.data.result[0].value[1]);

    if (probe.expectedMin && value < probe.expectedMin) {
      throw new Error(`${probe.name}: ${value} < expectedMin ${probe.expectedMin}`);
    }
    if (probe.expectedMax && value > probe.expectedMax) {
      throw new Error(`${probe.name}: ${value} > expectedMax ${probe.expectedMax}`);
    }
    console.log(`  [PASS] ${probe.name}: ${value}`);
  }
}

for (const probe of config.spec.probes) {
  await checkProbe(probe);
}
console.log('All steady-state probes passed');
```

## 渐进式实验策略：Staging → Canary → Prod

持续混沌的关键安全机制是**渐进式覆盖**，分三个环境层级：

| 阶段    | 环境              | 触发条件       | 实验强度               | 失败处理      |
| ------- | ----------------- | -------------- | ---------------------- | ------------- |
| L1 验证 | Staging           | 每次 PR        | 50% Pod 删除、网络延迟 | 阻断 PR 合并  |
| L2 验证 | Canary（1% 流量） | 每次部署到生产 | 20% Pod 删除           | 阻断全量部署  |
| L3 验证 | 生产全量          | 每周随机       | 低强度持续注入         | 告警+自动回滚 |

### Canary 阶段的混沌实验

```yaml
# chaos/suites/canary-suite.yaml
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:
  name: payment-canary-chaos
  namespace: production
  annotations:
    deployment-id: '${DEPLOYMENT_ID}' # 注入当前部署 ID
spec:
  appinfo:
    appns: production
    applabel: 'app=payment-service,track=canary' # 只针对 Canary Pod
    appkind: deployment

  experiments:
    - name: pod-delete
      spec:
        components:
          env:
            - name: TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION
              value: '120'
            - name: PODS_AFFECTED_PERC
              value: '20' # Canary 阶段只删 20%
```

### 生产持续注入：低强度随机

```yaml
# .github/workflows/continuous-chaos-prod.yaml
name: Continuous Chaos - Production

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * 2,4' # 每周二、四 10:00 UTC 执行

jobs:
  continuous-chaos:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production

    steps:
      - name: Pre-flight Check
        run: |
          # 确认当前没有进行中的告警
          python scripts/check-no-active-alerts.py \
            --prometheus-url ${{ secrets.PROMETHEUS_URL }}

      - name: Run Low-Intensity Chaos
        run: |
          kubectl apply -f chaos/suites/prod-low-intensity.yaml

      - name: Monitor for 10 Minutes
        run: sleep 600

      - name: Auto-rollback if Steady State Violated
        run: |
          node scripts/check-steady-state.js \
            --config chaos/steady-state.yaml \
            --namespace production || \
          kubectl delete -f chaos/suites/prod-low-intensity.yaml
```

## 混沌实验结果的可视化与报告

### Grafana 仪表板集成

在 Grafana 中标注混沌实验区间：

```json
{
  "annotations": {
    "list": [
      {
        "name": "Chaos Events",
        "datasource": "Loki",
        "expr": "{job=\"chaos-events\"} |= \"experiment_started\"",
        "iconColor": "red",
        "enable": true
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### PR 评论自动化报告

```yaml
- name: Post Chaos Report to PR
  uses: actions/github-script@v7
  with:
    script: |
      const verdict = '${{ steps.chaos-results.outputs.verdict }}'
      const icon = verdict === 'Pass' ? ':white_check_mark:' : ':x:'

      github.rest.issues.createComment({
        issue_number: context.issue.number,
        owner: context.repo.owner,
        repo: context.repo.repo,
        body: `## ${icon} Chaos Validation Report

        **Verdict**: ${verdict}
        **Experiments Run**: pod-delete, network-latency
        **Duration**: 120s
        **Steady State**: HTTP success rate > 99%, P99 < 200ms

        [View Grafana Dashboard](https://grafana.example.com/chaos-${context.sha})
        `
      })
```

## 关键指标：CI 混沌集成的健康度

| 指标               | 目标值           | 说明                            |
| ------------------ | ---------------- | ------------------------------- |
| 混沌覆盖率         | 100% 核心服务    | 所有核心服务都有 `chaos/` 目录  |
| PR 混沌通过率      | > 95%            | 偶发失败 < 5% 说明实验设计合理  |
| 失败阻断率         | 记录所有阻断事件 | 每次阻断都应有对应的修复 commit |
| 稳态验证覆盖维度   | ≥ 3 个 probe     | 至少覆盖成功率、延迟、Pod 数量  |
| 实验 YAML 变更频率 | 季度至少 1 次    | 说明实验在与服务同步演进        |

## 关键实践清单

- ChaosEngine YAML 与应用代码在同一个 PR 提交，确保实验与代码同步演进
- PR 流水线失败时，输出 Grafana 链接而不只是错误码，让开发者快速定位问题
- 生产持续注入实验必须有 pre-flight 检查（确认无活跃告警后才执行）
- 为混沌实验 ServiceAccount 配置最小权限，独立于应用 ServiceAccount
- 每季度审查一次实验 YAML，确保稳态假说与当前 SLO 保持一致

## 小结

持续混沌集成将韧性验证从季度 GameDay 压缩到每次 PR 的分钟级反馈。核心三步：第一，将 ChaosEngine YAML 存入 Git 仓库与应用代码同级管理；第二，通过 GitHub Actions 在 Staging 自动执行实验并验证稳态假说；第三，渐进式覆盖——Staging 全量验证、Canary 低强度验证、生产持续随机注入。这三步共同构成了 L4 持续混沌阶段的技术基础。结合前两篇的[成熟度模型](1_chaos-maturity-model.md)和[文化采纳](2_team-culture-adoption.md)，形成混沌工程技术+文化+自动化的完整闭环。
